controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery over the final Didymos v003 stereophotoclinometry shape. Image-resolved regions contain greater detail; smoothly modeled regions lack image coverage. The source estimates approximately 14 m uncertainty in each Cartesian axis and 3.3% in volume. This is a shape model, not a photograph or an albedo map.
controls.summary: An image-based shape model. Smooth regions lack image coverage; no surface photograph is mapped.
controls.title: SPC shape model v003

controls.label: DRACO mosaic
controls.description: Two DRACO frames from 158 and 94 seconds before impact. The later partial frame supplies closer detail; the earlier frame supplies wider coverage. The unseen surface keeps the grid. Each image is registered through its archived geometry and checked against the source shape. Brightness is approximately disk-normalized and matched over shared surface patches; shadows remain in the photographs. This is not measured albedo or a post-impact surface.
controls.summary: Two DRACO frames from 158 and 94 seconds before impact: one wider view and one closer partial view. Brightness is approximately normalized; photographed shadows remain. Grid marks unobserved or rejected areas.
controls.title: DART approach photographs

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows radius in the published Didymos shape minus a 365 m reference sphere. It includes the equatorial ridge and overall flattened shape; it is not height above a gravitational equipotential. Smooth regions are less constrained by images. Cartographic relief and optional Sun lighting are display treatments.
controls.summary: Height relative to a 365 m sphere, including the ridge. Smooth regions have weaker image constraints.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Grayscale shows the relative albedo solved with the final DART stereophotoclinometry shape. Values are relative brightness, not absolute geometric albedo or natural color. The gray grid marks facets without a multi-image uncertainty estimate; accepted source facets cover about 58% of the model area. This is a derived surface model, not a photograph.
controls.summary: Grayscale shows modeled brightness, not absolute albedo. Accepted facets cover about 58% of the shape; the grid marks the rest.
controls.title: Relative-albedo model
